name: Kirkland Pyra Fest 2024
information:
We encourage you to join us in Kirkland for a competition focused on side events! If you wish to also attend a competition with more traditional events like 3x3 and 2x2, you can view all the [many other competitions happening in Washington.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

Only **ONE guest** per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)
* [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/)

By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KirklandPyraFest2024#48269-please-read-competitor-responsibilities).
